thread:
ana: heads-up from canary this morning: saw duplicated subscription events and a quota blip for ws/chat-stream on eu-edge-4. console shows two near-identical increments for one reconnect. anyone on call?
leo: I saw that. looks like client negotiated ws subprotocol twice during resume and runtime emitted two 'subscription.confirm' telemetry events.
nana: (typo) ana: repro steps i used: open ws with `sec-websocket-protocol: chat.v1`, kill TCP, reconnect quickly. sometimes server accepts both the old connection (still half-open at proxy) and the new one and runtime treats them as two sessions.
peter: hmm proxy keepalive + subprotocol renegotiate race. proxy tries transparent reconnect and runtime resume also creates new session -> duplicate confirm.
sara: console-bot: Alert group ws-quota-chat fired at 04:02 UTC (2 hits) :warning:
leo: quick mitigation: runtime should dedupe subscription.confirm by flow_id or session_id+nonce. currently proxy-origin confirmations lack the session nonce, so dedupe fails.
nana: ana: here's the minimal repro i used with websocat:
```bash
# open
websocat -H "Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: chat.v1" wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/ws?route=chat
# kill from client side, reconnect within 200ms
websocat -H "Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: chat.v1" wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/ws?route=chat
```
sara: console UX asks if we can suppress these alerts when duplication ratio >90% attributable to subprotocol renegotiation. show a single consolidated spike and an explanatory note.
peter: planned fix: require proxy to forward `X-Session-Nonce` and `X-Flow-Id` on any keepalive/resume path. runtime will then prefer flow_id for counting. if flow_id absent, mark metric as POSSIBLE_DUP and don't trigger quota alert immediately.
leo: short-term hotfix: add 300ms buffer to finalize subscription confirm counts when subprotocol flag seen. that should collapse the duplicates in most races.
nana: ana: are we comfortable with 300ms? tests show it avoids 95% of duplicates with no visible UX regressions.
infra-bot: canary-deploy started for leo/ws-resume-dedupe (build 7012) -> edges eu-1, eu-4. monitor window 10m.
leo: canary looks good so far. token_count for chat route down 0.12%. duplicate_confirm events down 92%.
sara: i'll add a console banner copy: "Transient duplicate confirms detected during platform canary; we are suppressing noisy alerts while a fix rolls out." also muting the alert group until backfill completes.
peter: follow-up: open PR to enforce trace propagation at proxy #8342 and runtime changes #8346. backfill job queued to recompute counts for the 04:00-04:10 window. ETA 1h.
nana: ana: added unit test that simulates proxy+resume race and asserts single confirm emission. also added integration test with websocat script.
leo: thanks all. closing thread after backfill completes and PR merges.
console-bot: backfill job queued bf-9981 ETA 65m :white_check_mark:
